name: Russian Railways (RZD)
verdict: OAO Russian Railways is 100% owned by the Russian Federation (RZD charter, clause 32).
note: General sponsor of FC Lokomotiv (front and back of the 2026-27 home shirt; club partners page) and partner of HC Sochi. Also linked to Lokomotiv Yaroslavl. Propose severe: the Russian Federation wholly owns RZD and has been at war with Ukraine since February 2022 (mirrors the existing Aeroflot/Gazprom 'severe' ratings).
